Venezuela's Rodriguez Promises Elections at UN, No Date Set

Venezuela's interim President Delcy Rodriguez addressed the UN General Assembly on Wednesday, promising elections as part of a transition to "full democracy." Rodriguez stated that Venezuela is moving towards democracy and has initiated dialogue with opposition groups. However, she did not provide a specific date for the elections. The interim leader also spoke of an "orderly legal transition."
